(api-stellar-zams_effective_temperature)=
## `stellar.zams_effective_temperature`

*function*

[📇 model card](../15-model-reference/builders_stellar.md#card-zams_tout1996) · [∇ gradient-verified — 1 audit case](../50-validation/differentiability-audit.md)

```python
zams_effective_temperature(mass: Float[Array, '...'], Z: float = 0.02) -> Float[Array, '...']
```

ZAMS effective temperature [K] from mass [M_sun] via Stefan-Boltzmann.

T_eff = (L / (4 pi R^2 sigma))^(1/4), with L,R from the Tout+1996 relations
converted to cgs. Elementwise over `mass`; differentiable.

*Source: [`src/progenax/stellar.py#L113`](https://github.com/jaxstro/progenax/blob/main/src/progenax/stellar.py#L113)*

ZAMS surface gravity [log10(cm/s^2), dex] from mass [M_sun].

## `stellar.inverse_zams_luminosity`

*function*

[📇 model card](../15-model-reference/builders_stellar.md#card-zams_tout1996) · [∇ gradient-verified — 1 audit case](../50-validation/differentiability-audit.md)

```python
inverse_zams_luminosity(L_target: Float[Array, '...'], Z: float = 0.02) -> Float[Array, '...']
```

Invert L(M,Z): find M [M_sun] s.t. zams_luminosity(M,Z) = L_target.

Array-aware (vmaps the scalar Newton core internally) and differentiable via the
fixed-iteration `lax.scan` Newton. Returns a scalar for scalar input.

*Source: [`src/progenax/stellar.py#L165`](https://github.com/jaxstro/progenax/blob/main/src/progenax/stellar.py#L165)*
